description:
On 27th September, our Club co-sponsored Youth Conclave from 10 am to 12.30 noon at HPB Hinduja College, Worli as Platinum Co-Host Club.
DG Rtn. Rajan Dua was the Chief Guest along with DRR Rtr. Shreehari Nair as Guest of Honour.
The Conclave promoted diverse youth activities and projects, encouraged the formation of Interact and Rotaract Clubs, provided practical insights into conducting programs such as RYLA, RYPEN, MUNA and MIPS. Highlighted opportunities like RYE and NGSE that will truly change young lives. Showcased the impactful work of Rotaract and fostered joint engagement in service.
Attended by 3 Rotaractors
